slot.brief: Sum of an infinite GP where the first term/common ratio must be extracted from a repeating decimal or a given nth-term description; single-formula answer.

stem: The value of the repeating decimal $0.\overline{27}$, viewed as the sum of an infinite geometric series, is

verdicts.working: Treating it as a geometric series: \(0.27+0.0027+\cdots=\frac{0.27}{1-0.01}=\frac{3}{11}\).

working:
$0.\overline{27}=\dfrac{27}{100}+\dfrac{27}{100^2}+\cdots$\n$S=\dfrac{27/100}{1-1/100}=\dfrac{27}{99}=\dfrac{3}{11}$.

Independent check: Treating it as a geometric series: \(0.27+0.0027+\cdots=\frac{0.27}{1-0.01}=\frac{3}{11}\).
